title: Zero coordinates of a subset index
statement: For every natural number $n$, subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the subset index associated with $S$ has value zero at $i$ if and only if $i\notin S$.
